question: Should maintainers land this Android dead-code cleanup after exact-head CI completes?
rationale: The code review found no blocking defect, but the protected maintainer label keeps this out of autonomous cleanup or close decisions.

options.title: Land after CI
options.body: Merge once required exact-head Android/i18n checks finish green, preserving the current narrow deletion-only scope.

options.title: Hold for Android owner review
options.body: Pause if Android owners want a second review of the composer ownership boundary before deleting the orphaned implementation.

recommendation.title: Land after CI
